WHAT IS LOCAL SEO?

Local SEO is the process of optimizing your online presence to attract customers from local searches. When someone searches "dentist near me" or "best tacos in Seattle," local SEO determines whether your business shows up in the map pack and local results.

The Google local pack (the 3 businesses shown on a map) captures 44% of all clicks on local search results. If you're not in it, your competitors are — and they're getting your customers.

Local SEO combines Google Business Profile optimization, local citation building, review management, and localized keyword tracking to get you into the map pack and keep you there.

GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE OPTIMIZATION

Your Google Business Profile is the most important local SEO asset you have. It shows in Google Maps, the local pack, and Google Search panels. An unoptimized GBP is like a billboard with the wrong phone number.

✓Primary and secondary category selection
✓Service area configuration
✓High-quality photo uploads (interior, exterior, team, products)
✓Weekly Google Posts (offers, events, updates)
✓Q&A monitoring and pre-seeded answers
✓Attribute optimization (women-owned, accessible, etc.)
✓Review response strategy
✓Booking/appointment link integration

RANK TRACKING FOR LOCAL KEYWORDS

National rank tracking tools show you where you rank in aggregate. But local searches are hyper-specific — your rank in the neighborhood 2 miles north may be completely different from your rank 5 miles south.

Our rank tracking tool monitors your positions at the ZIP code level, so you know exactly where you're winning and where you're losing. Track up to 500 keywords across unlimited locations.
